blurb: The Flight King offers private jet charters with a range of aircraft from light jets to heavy jets, providing luxury amenities and personalized concierge services. They also provide discounted business and first class airfare with 24/7 concierge support. Their services include corporate jet charters, empty leg flights, and customized travel arrangements including ground transportation and catering.
extraNote: No membership fees; pay only for booked flights · Concierge handles all flight changes and cancellations · Travel insurance available including trip cancellation and medical assistance · Private terminals (FBO) for private jet check-in
